answer: By the cipher of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. The nectar lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the cedar is where a second reviewer recomputes them. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
